name: Counter relay with electrical reset
summary: An electrically reset counter relay has a separate reset command or documented electronic reset mechanism.
description: An electrically reset counter relay has a separate reset command or documented electronic reset mechanism. Schematics need the count and reset paths to remain distinct.
readingNotes: Establish reset priority where count and reset signals can occur together.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Electrical reset changes the counter state; it is not the same as disconnecting the measured circuit.
